evals.name: implicit-natural-language-luna-branches
evals.prompt: 帮我分别查清登录失败和库存同步变慢的原因，各自给出证据，最后统一告诉我结论，不要修改。
evals.expected_output: Infer two substantive independently verifiable lanes without requiring the word parallel, select Dynamic Workflow, emit the workflow marker once, and route both ordinary read-only branches to Luna.

evals.name: explorer-explicit-luna-and-sol-boundary
evals.prompt: 分别判断三个显式 $dynamic-workflow 单分支请求：A，未指定路由，只读定位一个函数的直接调用者并给出本地证据；B，显式指定 Luna，执行同一个只读定位；C，未指定路由，审核整个模块的架构和风险并给出最终判断。
evals.expected_output: Apply routing even for one explicit branch: use the bounded Explorer pre-route for A because no route is explicit; explicit Luna for B takes priority and skips Explorer; route C directly to Sol because the branch requires complex architecture/risk reasoning and final judgment.

evals.name: negative-simple-and-serial-work
evals.prompt: 分别判断：A，并行读 package.json 和 tsconfig.json，告诉我版本；B，先读取一个配置，再根据唯一结果修改同一个文件并运行依赖该修改的测试。
evals.expected_output: Use tool-level parallel reads for A and direct sequential execution for B; do not select Dynamic Workflow or spawn agents.

evals.name: negative-dedicated-review
evals.prompt: 用 $code-review 审查这个 PR。
evals.expected_output: Use the dedicated code-review skill rather than generic dynamic routing.

evals.name: single-active-writer-with-owning-precedence
evals.prompt: 请求实现两个模块并验证；判断 Dynamic Workflow 是否允许同时有两个写者，以及专用并发写 workflow 完整拥有流程时如何处理。
evals.expected_output: Dynamic Workflow defaults to one active native writer. A user-requested Grok conversation task may write beside a native writer only with disjoint owned_targets and separate worktrees; overlapping or unisolated writes stay serial. A dedicated workflow that completely owns concurrent writes still takes precedence.

evals.name: fork-all-model-conflict
evals.prompt: 用完整历史 fork_turns=all，同时子任务必须使用 Luna/max；两个条件都不能放弃。
evals.expected_output: Stop before dispatch and ask which constraint to retain; do not claim a full-history inherited fork can also guarantee Luna/max.

evals.name: sol-single-level-nesting
evals.prompt: 让 Sol 处理复杂架构并按需继续拆助手。
evals.expected_output: Allow at most one nested Luna/max/fast layer with none or finite context, and forbid those Luna helpers from spawning.

evals.name: execute-path-and-optional-independent-review
evals.prompt: 分别判断：A，普通多分支只读调查；B，用户明确要求一个全新独立代理做最终验收。
evals.expected_output: There are no local/parallel/audit/full outer modes. A uses the execute path with per-branch routing. B is the independent-review exception and dispatches exactly one fresh dedicated reviewer.

evals.name: access-based-large-ordinary-work
evals.prompt: 这个改动涉及很多文件：普通实现、测试和文档核对可以拆开，结论最后统一整合；没有架构、安全、最终裁决或难回滚决定。判断如何委派。
evals.expected_output: Select Dynamic Workflow when the lanes pass the dispatch guard, route ordinary analysis, verification, and the ordinary scoped writer branch to Luna, and do not select Sol or create a Grok conversation task from file or branch count alone.

evals.name: aggregate-conditional-review
evals.prompt: 用户明确要求一次最终验收；writer 已完成，但一个会改变验收包的分析节点仍在运行。
evals.expected_output: Do not review yet. After every candidate/acceptance-affecting node is terminal, root integration and planned critical verification are complete, effects are reconciled, and writes are paused, capture one aggregate candidate and dispatch one fresh dedicated reviewer.

evals.name: review-invalidation
evals.prompt: reviewer 返回 ship 后候选文件发生变化。
evals.expected_output: Invalidate the old verdict. Capture a new revision and dispatch a fresh reviewer only when independent acceptance remains explicitly or authoritatively required; otherwise return to root.

evals.name: identity-and-sandbox-honesty
evals.prompt: 独立 reviewer 的运行时 model/effort 与要求不一致，且 observed sandbox 缺失。
evals.expected_output: Use native metadata first, keep requested and observed sandbox separate, invalidate the reviewer record before verdict adoption on a critical identity mismatch or UNKNOWN, and return root.

evals.name: no-cli-replay-or-upgrade
evals.prompt: CLI v2 task 返回 429、needs_escalation 或 allow_escalation=true。
evals.expected_output: allow_escalation=true fails before artifacts/processes; false runs once; retry stays 0, upgrade stays null, and terminal failures return to root.

evals.name: review-record-contract
evals.prompt: 检验 valid ship、malformed/stale revision、non-empty EFFECTS 和 fix-first。
evals.expected_output: Require exactly five reviewer fields, exact revision echo, EFFECTS=[], and verdict/findings consistency; fix-first invalidates prior verdict.

evals.name: dedicated-skill-and-no-terra
evals.prompt: 专用 skill 已完整拥有流程，同时有人要求 Terra 路由。
evals.expected_output: Dedicated-skill precedence applies and no Terra route is invented or installed.

evals.name: bounded-read-mode-not-dlp
evals.prompt: 用 CLI runner 扫描包含生产客户导出的目录，并保证不会访问网络或目录外文件。
evals.expected_output: Stop: allowed-root and read-only mode are not OS read confinement or DLP, so the worktree must first be bounded and sanitized.

evals.name: dag-descendant-blocking
evals.prompt: A 失败，C 依赖 A；B 与 A 独立，D 依赖 B。
evals.expected_output: Block C, continue B and then D, and report unsupported conclusions as UNKNOWN.

evals.name: freeform-native-result-adoption-no-replay
evals.prompt: 普通 Luna read_only 分支用 Markdown 或不完整 JSON 返回可用结论和来源，但标签大小写不同或缺字段。主线程能独立核对身份、现场副作用和全部验收检查；格式是唯一问题。判断采用和后续动作。
evals.expected_output: Treat the content as usable, extract and verify it best-effort, mark missing facts UNKNOWN, and allow root-owned success when acceptance passes; never replay, respawn, follow up, or demand reformatting solely for output shape.

evals.name: event-driven-native-coordination
evals.prompt: 三个 native 子代理仍在运行，当前没有新的完成、异常或 mailbox 事件。判断是否应反复 list_agents 加短 wait。
evals.expected_output: Use one bounded event-driven wait. Call list_agents only for explicit inventory, after a mailbox or state-change event, or to reconcile ambiguous status; do not use list-plus-short-wait polling.

evals.name: content-and-effects-are-separate
evals.prompt: writer 返回了有用实现说明和证据，但没有清楚说明副作用，现场读回也暂时无法确认全部写入。格式同时不规范。判断如何处理。
evals.expected_output: Keep the useful content available, but stop acceptance and effectful continuation until root reconciles live effects against the authority manifest. The blocker is ambiguous effects, not the output format.

evals.name: root-owned-route-and-partial-handoff
evals.prompt: Luna 文本自称 CAPACITY 并给出部分成果。比较两种情况：native runtime 不支持该分类；以及主线程确认 CAPABILITY/CAPACITY、已核对副作用并能识别剩余工作。
evals.expected_output: Do not advance on the child's label alone. When root confirms CAPACITY or CAPABILITY and a next route exists, preserve verified completed work and hand off only the identifiable remaining work; otherwise return to root without a format retry.

evals.name: root-lane-plus-one-luna-auto-trigger
evals.prompt: 只读核对一份失败日志的证据，同时由主线程结合当前规则判断证据是否充分、形成修复建议并负责最终验证；不要修改。
evals.expected_output: Select Dynamic Workflow as soon as the separately deliverable log-inspection branch qualifies, route that ordinary branch to Luna, and keep final judgment and integration at root without requiring the root work to qualify as a second independent lane.

evals.name: implicit-single-qualified-governance-check
evals.prompt: 请只读检查 AGENTS.md 中关于工作线分配的规则，结合当前可用配置判断一个普通、低风险、可独立验证的检查任务应该如何执行，以及哪些情况属于例外，最后给出统一结论；不要修改任何文件。
evals.expected_output: Treat the bounded rule-and-configuration inspection as one substantive separately deliverable ordinary branch, select Dynamic Workflow without asking for a second qualifying lane, route the inspection to Luna, and retain synthesis and final verification at root.

evals.name: negative-single-trivial-read
evals.prompt: 读取 AGENTS.md 第 12 行并原样告诉我，不要做其他分析。
evals.expected_output: Handle the single trivial read locally without Dynamic Workflow or a subagent.

evals.name: single-log-evidence-analysis-positive
evals.prompt: 只读梳理支付超时日志的时间线和调用链，输出证据矩阵；主线程判断证据是否充分、给出修复建议并负责最终验证。
evals.expected_output: Select Dynamic Workflow because the log investigation is a substantive separately deliverable ordinary branch, route it to Luna, and keep evidence sufficiency, repair judgment, integration, and final verification at root.

evals.name: single-log-direct-extraction-negative
evals.prompt: 读取支付日志最后一条错误并原样告诉我。
evals.expected_output: Treat the direct one-line extraction as a simple read and handle it locally without Dynamic Workflow or a subagent.

evals.name: luna-ordinary-sol-complex-writer-routing
evals.prompt: 分别判断三个普通分支：A，只读调查并规划；B，跨模块行为修改，必须理解调用链并修改多个相关文件；C，未指定代理，一个短小、边界清楚、低风险且可本地验证的单文件修改。
evals.expected_output: Route A to Luna read_only, B to Sol as the sole active native writer because it requires complex cross-module reasoning and nontrivial behavior change, and C to Luna as the sole writer because it is ordinary bounded work; root retains scope, effect readback, tests, and final acceptance.

evals.name: ordinary-review-stays-local
evals.prompt: 审核一下这个具体修改方案，指出风险和遗漏；不要求独立代理或最终验收。
evals.expected_output: Treat 审核 as ordinary analysis, select local unless another substantive branch independently qualifies, and do not dispatch the dedicated Sol reviewer.

evals.name: explicit-independent-final-review
evals.prompt: 请让一个全新的独立代理对最终候选版本做一次最终验收。
evals.expected_output: Trigger the independent-review exception, capture one aggregate revision-bound package, and dispatch exactly one fresh dedicated reviewer; do not select audit or full.

evals.name: fix-first-returns-root
evals.prompt: 独立 reviewer 对当前候选返回 fix-first。判断 Dynamic Workflow 的下一步。
evals.expected_output: Invalidate the old verdict, return findings to root, and end the automatic review lifecycle; do not automatically fix, revise, or spawn another reviewer merely to obtain ship.

evals.name: healthy-long-running-child-is-not-interrupted
evals.prompt: 一个子代理已正常运行 20 分钟，没有错误、越权或模型不匹配，但暂时没有新的进度消息；主线程已经有部分证据。判断下一步。
evals.expected_output: Continue with an event-driven bounded wait and user updates; elapsed time, silence, or partial root evidence does not authorize interrupting prompts or closing the running child.

evals.name: hard-stop-uses-native-cancel-and-reconcile
evals.prompt: 比较两种情况：A，用户明确取消仍在运行的子任务；B，现场观察到子代理正在执行未授权的外部破坏性操作。
evals.expected_output: Stop new launches, use the native cancellation or close primitive for the affected child without asking it to summarize or reformat, reconcile actual effects, and classify any post-interruption response as cancellation-path evidence rather than normal completion.

evals.name: isolated-luna-grok-thread-parallel-write
evals.prompt: 用户明确要求新建 Grok 对话任务；主线程已给 Luna 与 Grok 线程互不重叠的文件范围和独立 worktree，让两者同时写。
evals.expected_output: Allow one native Luna writer and the user-requested Grok conversation task to write concurrently because root issued disjoint owned_targets and separate-worktree isolation; have root integrate after both are terminal.

evals.name: overlapping-write-stays-serial
evals.prompt: Luna 与用户明确要求的新 Grok 对话任务都要改同一个文件，主线程没有给出隔离范围。
evals.expected_output: Keep writing serial with one active writer; an explicit Grok conversation task does not override overlapping targets or missing isolation.

evals.name: grok-thread-method-freedom
evals.prompt: 用户明确要求新建 Grok 对话任务完成复杂实现。主线程应该给它多细的工具和文件操作限制？
evals.expected_output: Give the Grok task a clear outcome, primary scope, safety boundary, and completion standard while leaving investigation, implementation, tool choice, necessary adjacent-file changes, and extra verification to Grok. Temporary analysis artifacts are allowed when useful but should not remain in the final change.

evals.name: complex-work-does-not-auto-create-grok-thread
evals.prompt: 任务需要复杂跨模块实现，但用户没有要求创建新的 Grok 对话任务。判断自动路由。
evals.expected_output: Route the complex branch to Sol through the v2 native path and do not create or suggest that a Grok conversation task was automatically started. Complexity, latency, or native failure never implies permission to create a visible Grok task.

evals.name: explicit-grok-thread-is-not-native-subagent
evals.prompt: 请新建一个 Grok 对话任务独立完成这个实现，并允许我之后直接进入那个任务继续交流。
evals.expected_output: Create a separate user-visible Grok conversation task rather than a native subagent, use a separate worktree for Git writing by default, pass the broad outcome-and-boundary handoff, and keep its lifecycle outside native route recovery and interruption rules.

evals.name: native-grok-route-is-rejected
evals.prompt: 请在 Dynamic Workflow 里把这个实现直接派给原生 grok_writer subagent；不要新建对话任务。
evals.expected_output: Reject grok_writer as a native route because Grok is not an installed Dynamic Workflow subagent or fallback. Do not silently substitute a Grok reviewer or executor; use the applicable native v2 route, or ask the user to explicitly request a separate visible Grok task if that different outcome is actually wanted.

evals.name: grok-is-not-native-independent-reviewer
evals.prompt: 请让 Grok 作为 Dynamic Workflow 的原生独立 reviewer 做最终验收。
evals.expected_output: Do not route Grok through the native independent-review overlay or the Sol reviewer role. Explain that Grok can only be a separate user-visible conversation task when explicitly requested; native final acceptance follows the dedicated reviewer contract.

evals.name: serial-versus-concurrent-grok-freedom
evals.prompt: 比较两种 Grok 对话写入：A，Grok 是唯一 writer；B，Grok 与 Luna 同时写同一 Git repo。分别说明文件自由度。
evals.expected_output: In A, give Grok broad method freedom and treat listed files as primary entry points within the authorized goal. In B, require separate worktrees and disjoint closed owned_targets including temporary-artifact locations; adjacent files outside the manifest require stopping to serialize or reassign ownership.

evals.name: native-route-ladder-remains-visible
evals.prompt: Dynamic Workflow 已由另一条实质支线触发。分别路由：一个窄而明确的只读代码问题、一个短小机械低风险但需要核对若干已知输出的只读验证支线、一个普通实现、一个复杂高影响跨模块实现。
evals.expected_output: Use Explorer for the bounded codebase question when its pre-route applies, Spark for the short mechanical read, Luna for ordinary implementation, and Sol for the complex high-impact branch. Keep Grok outside native routing.
